findings.message: DROP COLUMN permanently deletes the column's data and breaks still-deployed code that reads it.
findings.recommendation: Expand-contract: stop reading/writing the column in code first, drop it in a later migration.
findings.snippet: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN name;

findings.message: Adding a NOT NULL column without a DEFAULT fails on non-empty tables (and rewrites/locks on older engines).
findings.recommendation: Add nullable (or constant DEFAULT on PG 11+), backfill in batches, then SET NOT NULL separately.
findings.snippet: ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN email TEXT NOT NULL;

findings.message: CREATE INDEX without CONCURRENTLY blocks writes to the table while it builds.
findings.recommendation: Use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY (outside a transaction) for production tables.
